1.bug_scenario: The bug involves the Overlay component where inline content collapses due to insufficient space for rendering. The issue can be resolved by setting the width to 100%. The image shows an overlay with a message that will close after 3 seconds or can be closed manually. The overlay is not expanding to the full width, causing content collapse.
